name: TX-03
label: Likely R

key_factors: Incumbent Keith Self running with a large fundraising edge
Polymarket prices Self at ~94% to win
No public polling of the race
model.rationale: The R+11 district lean, Self's incumbency and roughly doubled fundraising, and prediction markets pricing him near 94% all point to a comfortable Republican hold, with only modest tightening from the favorable Democratic environment. Hunt's modest cash leaves little sign of a serious threat.
model.watch: Any late independent polling or major outside spending against Self would be the first signal of a genuine race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Keith Self seeks a second term in this Collin County-area seat, a district that leaned about eleven points Republican at the presidential level in 2024. Self won his 2024 race by a wide margin and enters the general with a clear financial advantage, having raised roughly $841,000 to Evan Hunt's $447,000, and holds a large cash-on-hand edge. Outside spending has so far favored Self, with no recorded opposition spending against him.

Hunt, a first-time challenger, has not attracted expert ratings or public polling, and prediction markets give him only a small chance of an upset. The national political environment may be somewhat friendlier to Democrats than in 2024, but the district's lean and Self's incumbency make this a race Republicans are strongly favored to hold, with a Democratic win possible only in a major wave scenario.
